en: A sepia-toned studio photograph showing a uniformed man and a maid in a posed, slightly humorous domestic scene. The man wears an early-20th‑century military-style tunic with stand-up collar, metal buttons, and a flat-topped cap, while the woman in a striped dress, white apron, and maid's cap adjusts or wipes his sleeve beside a tiled kitchen counter. The background is a plain studio backdrop; there is no visible printed caption or border text on the front.
